newsitem.title: Sri lanka: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - April 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - April 3.

text.p: Following were the leading stories in Sri Lankan newspapers on Thursday Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Police offer 750,000-rupee reward for information on two private bank officials wanted for embezzling 12.8 million rupees.
Speculation is rife that Britain is to mediate in Sri Lanka's ethnic conflict after Dr Liam Fox, Undersecretary for Commonwealth and Foreign Affairs, arrived in Colombo on Tuesday.
Police arrest owner of job recruitment agency with stock of counterfeit Italian currency notes in Wennappuva, north of Colombo.
Judge who allegedly sexually assaulted girl working in his house surrenders to a magistrate in a Colombo suburb.
